summary: VDD skill creates/repairs complete execution-plan directories only on explicit request; standalone requirements files route to direct implementation. Select standard/resumable/self-hosted profile before model routing; record rationale and required artifacts. Read mandatory authority references, perform knowledge-consumption and skill-input gates before plan-ready; failed or insufficient required matches block readiness. Lifecycle: draft -> plan-ready -> implementation-authorized -> implementation-complete -> acceptance-passed -> archived; Bootstrap is supplemental. Plans define slices, observable behavior, failure intent, acceptance, dependencies, recovery, baseline/current scope, validation, and terminal full check; VDD does not own RED execution. Repairs are in-place under repair/round-n, preserve history, bind findings and hashes, require callsite inventory, composition receipts, changed-set completeness, and targeted stabilization before terminal replay. Bootstrap lineage uses stable family, two-round default, three-round hard limit with typed triggers; exhaustion pauses. Resumable/self-hosted require append-only 95 report/index. Keep artifacts generic and avoid live paths, IDs, hashes, or machine-specific data.
